answer: Identity-bond decay stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks a 100 POA bond shrinking 5% per epoch without verified work: work is the trellis, the bond a vine climbing only while it produces. Below 20 POA, its nadir, it loses write access until topped up. 100 fakes lock 10,000 POA and cost 500 POA per epoch to stand still, 10,000 POA over 20 epochs. An honest agent pays once and its work keeps the bond whole, so joining stays cheap, fakery ruinous.
